photos.title: Shaftesbury Glen from above
photos.what: Part of Shaftesbury Glen from above (USDA NAIP aerial photo, 2023): the golf club's fairways and greens beside curving streets of houses, with the row of The Villas beside the road. The Preserve, the newest section, was not built yet.
photos.caption: The golf club's fairways beside the streets of The Landing and the older sections, from before The Preserve was built.
photos.alt: Aerial photo of part of Shaftesbury Glen near Conway: golf fairways and greens beside curving streets of houses, a row of villas along a road and a pond between the houses and the course
photos.author: USDA Farm Service Agency, NAIP
photos.provenance: U.S. government aerial photo: USDA National Agriculture Imagery Program (NAIP), South Carolina 2023 (flight tile m_3307801_se_17_060_20230410), natural color, 60 cm. Exported by Chapter3 from the USGS National Map NAIP image service (exportImage, Web Mercator, cubic resampling) on 2026-11-17; the exact request is in source_request. The image service identify call at the frame returns the 2023 tile.
photos.license_note: Same source and terms as the NAIP records of /submarkets/garden-city/ (data/2026-11-a/submarkets-garden-city/photos.json): The National Map offers free downloads of public domain NAIP orthoimagery; the USDA FSA policy page says public domain information may be freely distributed or copied, with credit requested.
photos.credit: Photo: USDA Farm Service Agency, NAIP, public domain, via The National Map (USGS).
photos.changes: Chapter3 Realty cut this view from the NAIP service (4:3)
photos.subject_check: Looked at full size by the writer of /submarkets/conway/shaftesbury-glen/ on 2026-11-17. The houses in the frame are on Shaftesbury Glen lots (The Landing, the older sections and The Villas). No person; cars in one parking lot are too small to read a plate at page size; no house number or sign readable.
photos.crop_note: The 1x1, 4x3 and 16x9 share crops are center crops of the same 1800x1350 export.
